mapper.select: select id from pep_platform.app_user order by id
select distinct r.code from pep_platform.role_binding b join pep_platform.role r on r.id = b.role_id where b.principal_type = 'USER' and b.principal_id = #{userId}::text order by r.code

select distinct p.permission_code from pep_platform.role_binding b join pep_platform.role_permission p on p.role_id = b.role_id where b.principal_type = 'USER' and b.principal_id = #{userId}::text order by p.permission_code
select code, name from pep_platform.role order by code
select p.permission_code from pep_platform.role_permission p join pep_platform.role r on r.id = p.role_id where r.code = #{roleCode} order by p.permission_code
mapper.delete: delete from pep_platform.role_permission where role_id = (select id from pep_platform.role where code = #{roleCode})
mapper.update: update pep_platform.app_user set auth_version = auth_version + 1 where id in ( select b.principal_id::bigint from pep_platform.role_binding b join pep_platform.role r on r.id = b.role_id where b.principal_type = 'USER' and r.code = #{roleCode})
mapper.select: select count(*) from pep_platform.app_user where username = #{username}
mapper.insert: insert into pep_platform.app_user (username, password_hash, enabled, created_at, issuer, subject, display_name, state, tenant_id, updated_at) values (#{user.username}, #{user.passwordHash}, #{user.enabled}, #{user.createdAt}, 'local', #{user.username}, #{user.username}, case when #{user.enabled} then 'ACTIVE' else 'DISABLED' end, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', now())

with tenant_row as ( insert into pep_platform.tenant_member (tenant_id, user_id) values ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', #{userId}) on conflict do nothing ), project_row as ( insert into pep_platform.project_member (project_id, user_id) values ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', #{userId}) on conflict do nothing ) select 1
mapper.update: update pep_platform.app_user set enabled = #{enabled}, state = case when #{enabled} then 'ACTIVE' else 'DISABLED' end, auth_version = auth_version + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from pep_platform.role_binding where principal_type = 'USER' and principal_id = #{userId}::text
mapper.insert: insert into pep_platform.role_binding (id, principal_type, principal_id, role_id, scope_type, scope_id) select gen_random_uuid(), 'USER', #{userId}::text, r.id, r.scope_type, case r.scope_type when 'PLATFORM' then '*' when 'TENANT' then '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' else '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002' end from pep_platform.role r where r.code = #{roleCode} on conflict do nothing
